claudeMd:
# My marketing work

I work in marketing. Before the first piece for a brand, ask me once who the audience is and what the goal is, and save the answer in `CLAUDE/patterns/`. Next time, use what's saved.

Marketing text that doesn't sound like AI: no "it's not X, it's Y" in a row, no closing a paragraph with a catchphrase, no lists where every line has the same format. Write the way someone from the brand would talk to a customer. When I ask for options, give me three that are very different from each other, not three versions of the same idea.
primeiraVitoria: Let's do the first real task now: my next piece of content. Ask me what post, ad or campaign I need to deliver and who it's for. Then write 3 versions that are very different from each other, in my tone, and tell me which one you'd pick and why. Save the versions in a note in my second brain.
semana: Turn a piece of content that worked into 5 new ideas in the same format.
Write the caption and the first 3 seconds of a video I'm going to record.
Lay out the post calendar for the next two weeks from my topics.
Analyze 3 competitors I name and tell me what they do that I don't.
Rewrite a page or bio of mine so it makes more sense to someone seeing it for the first time.
Note in my second brain the tone of voice we used this week, so you get it right the first time from now on.
